Security-reviewer C1 CRITICAL resolved: PutEventSelectors is a REPLACE op — previous naive impl wiped prior buckets on every new bucket create — now uses GetEventSelectorsCommand → mergeBucketIntoSelectors (immutable clone) → PutEventSelectorsCommand, covered by tests for merge, idempotency, propagation. Sec-H2 resolved: try/catch rollback via best-effort DeleteBucket on any post-create step failure + console.warn on rollback failure. Code-H1 resolved: BucketLocationConstraint type import replaces unsafe literal cast. Code-H2 resolved: getCloudTrailClient singleton passes explicit AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/SECRET so credential chain cannot diverge from S3 client in dev. Sec/Code-L resolved: TOCTOU BucketNotEmpty rewrap. Added config.ts AWS_CLOUDTRAIL_NAME optional env with empty-string→undefined transform. Carry-forward to deploy runbook: (a) logs bucket must exist with S3 LogDelivery group ACL grants (sec-M2 preflight deferred to avoid over-engineering); (b) HTTPS-only policy locks out root account for non-HTTPS ops — document; (c) listHipaaBuckets currently returns entire account — F5.1 will filter by DB-scoped managed buckets; (d) assert account-level S3 BPA at deploy time. ContentType signed via signableHeaders so uploader cannot swap MIME type post-signature.
